--surface-color-text.description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Text color for a contrasted surface, legible against the contrasted background. This channel is unique to `contrasted` (and any future polarity-inverting surface): a depth surface (layer1/2/3) keeps the ambient page polarity, so its text stays `--color-text` and it deliberately emits no `--surface-color-text`. Consume as `var(--surface-color-text, var(--color-text))` — the fallback is the surface family's consistency mechanism: polarity-inverting surfaces override, same-polarity surfaces fall through.
